@NativeType("struct glslang_spv_options_t") public class GLSLangSPVOptions extends Struct<GLSLangSPVOptions> implements NativeResource
struct glslang_spv_options_t {
    bool generate_debug_info;
    bool strip_debug_info;
    bool disable_optimizer;
    bool optimize_size;
    bool disassemble;
    bool validate;
    bool emit_nonsemantic_shader_debug_info;
    bool emit_nonsemantic_shader_debug_source;
    bool compile_only;
    bool optimize_allow_expanded_id_bound;
}
